_comment: Everything configurable in the calculation and the page. A project overrides any key in project.json -> display.
_unitAliases: Spellings of the same unit, merged after trimming
_subtradeAliases: Spaces around hyphens are removed first, so 'Plinth Beam - RCC' already reads 'Plinth Beam-RCC'

location._comment: Area and sub-location from the location text. tokenRules first: a building token anywhere in the value (any prefix, suffix or separator) sets the area and becomes the sub-location, e.g. 'SS_DC-2A' -> DC Building / DC-2A. Otherwise split on the delimiter ('GIS_Transformer Yard' -> GIS / Transformer Yard; a bare value is the whole area), then map the area through areaAliases.

statusColors._comment: VisiLean task status colours; the 3D model's Task status view colours elements with them
